raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Adds B200 (SM100) plans for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next TP=1 BF16 linears; SM100 had TP=4 shapes only.

## Claims

- 1.35–2.24x over cuBLAS per projection; ≈ 0.6 ms saved per decode step at bs1.

## Validation

```
pytest tests/kernels/test_bf16_skinny_gemm.py -k qwen4_exp          → 38 passed, 99 skipped (B200)
qwen4_exp_low_latency_gemm vs F.linear (CUPTI, CUDA graph, 7 cells) → all faster, cold and hot L2
```

| projection | (N, K) | M | cuBLAS → plan (µs, cold L2) | speedup cold / hot |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GDN B/A | (96, 2560) | 1 | 5.44 → 2.43 | 2.24x / 3.20x |
| router | (512, 2560) | 1 | 6.11 → 2.98 | 2.05x / 2.91x |
| shared gate/up | (1280, 2560) | 1 | 6.40 → 4.22 | 1.52x / 1.70x |
| shared down | (2560, 640) | 1 | 4.48 → 3.17 | 1.41x / 1.57x |
| shared down | (2560, 640) | 2 | 4.54 → 3.36 | 1.35x / 1.38x |
| GDN/QSA out | (2560, 6144) | 1 | 11.71 → 8.19 | 1.43x / 1.97x |
| GDN/QSA out | (2560, 6144) | 2 | 11.42 → 8.45 | 1.35x / 1.36x |

## Details

Losing shapes stay on cuBLAS. No e2e.

---
